body:
### Problem

When using `vim.hl.range` or `nvim_buf_set_extmark` set extmarks (signs,
highlights) for a terminal buffer, then using `clear`, `reset` or `<C-l>`
clears the buffer. The `extmarks` aren't cleared or updated.

And When the terminal buffer is re-sized if there are some lines that are longer
than the re-sized terminal buffer width. Those lines will be automatically re-sized,
regardless of `wrap` option(this seems to be on purpose).
But the wrapping does not behave like the `wrap` option in a normal buffer. 
When a line is wrapped, the wrapped text is placed on a new physical line. 
Thus, all lines below it are shifted down by one line, but the `extmarks` aren't updated.

### Steps to reproduce

I have two examples to reproduce this problem. The example 2 comes from the
help page `:h terminal-osc133`

example_1.lua
```lua
-- 1. execute the ex cmd `vertical term`
-- 2. echo "https://neovim.io"
-- 3. source this file

local term_buf = 2
local ns_id = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("term_bug_ns")
vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "TermUnderline", { underline = true, ctermfg = 1 })

-- When executing clear, reset or <C-l> in terminal buffer,
-- the highlights related to that line isn't cleared by neovim.

vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(term_buf, ns_id, 0, -1)

-- both functions can produce this problem
-- vim.hl.range(term_buf, ns_id, "TermUnderline", { 2, 0 }, { 2, 17 }, {})
vim.api.nvim_buf_set_extmark(term_buf, ns_id, 2, 0, {
    end_row = 2,
    end_col = 17,
    hl_group = "TermUnderline",
})
```

example_2.lua
```lua
-- 1. Source this file, then open neovim's terminal
-- 2. exectue this line below inside the terminal(bash)
-- PROMPT_COMMAND='printf "\033]133;A\007"'

-- This code snippet comes from the help page. `:h terminal-osc133`
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('TermOpen', {
    command = 'setlocal signcolumn=auto',
})
local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace('my.terminal.prompt')
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('TermRequest', {
    callback = function(ev)
    if string.match(ev.data.sequence, '^\027]133;A') then
        local lnum = ev.data.cursor[1]
        vim.api.nvim_buf_set_extmark(ev.buf, ns, lnum - 1, 0, {
        sign_text = '▶',
        sign_hl_group = 'SpecialChar',
        })
    end
    end,
})
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/552de295-6255-45e8-8523-dde48e5d8748

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9cd2b2d0-5492-43e7-8cf0-0df92025542b

**Look at line 19 before and after executing the `:vnew` command.**

After that problem being occured, `[[` and `]]` opertors metioned in `:h terminal-osc133`
also don't work properly. They will jump to the line that has the sign mark.

After executing `clear` command, the sign marks aren't updated correctly and
`[[` and `]]` also can jump to empty lines.

### Expected behavior

The signs and highlights should be updated correctly when the lines are wrapped or removed.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.12.5

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A

### Operating system/version

Void Linux

### Terminal name/version

alacritty 0.17.0

### $TERM environment variable

tmux-256color

### Installation

build from repo
